disagreements.judge_why: The summary's position that direct payment is handled via pre-authorisation for a planned admission at a network hospital is fully supported by passage [1].

The summary supports a PAYABLE position for a second own damage claim under No Claim Bonus Protection, but passage [1] explicitly states that a second claim in the same policy year results in the No Claim Bonus reverting to nil.
The summary concludes the claim is PAYABLE while citing a passage that states Nil Depreciation is limited to two claims per policy year and the claim file records this is the third claim [1].

verdicts.why: The compulsory deductible of INR 3,000 for vehicles above 1500cc is supported by Endorsement 1 [2], which is current for the date of loss 2026-07-21.

The summary correctly applies the updated co-payment percentage of 10% for members aged 66 and over based on Endorsement 2 [1], which supersedes the base policy figure [2] in accordance with the precedence rule [4].
The 15-day submission deadline comes from passage [1] effective 2025-04-01, which is prior to the 2026-06-14 date of loss, and no retrieved passage confirms it remains current.
The summary correctly applies the exclusion for treatment taken outside India from passage [1], which is confirmed as unchanged by passage [2] for claim CLM-2026-00567.

The summary concludes the claim is PAYABLE [1], but passage [1] states that nil depreciation does not extend to tyres, tubes, and batteries, on which a 50% depreciation continues to apply, and the claim file involves damage to tyres alone with no other part of the vehicle damaged.
The summary correctly relies on passage [1] to support the pro-rata refund position for an annual policy cancelled by the policyholder with no claims made.

The summary correctly relies on passages [1] and [4] to determine that non-medical items such as hand wash, shoe covers, and attendant charges are non-payable items or subsumed into room charges for claim CLM-2026-00442.
The summary's position that direct payment is handled via pre-authorisation for a planned admission at a network hospital is fully supported by passage [1].
The summary's position that expenses for an admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation are not payable is fully supported by passage [1].

The summary supports a PAYABLE position using the proportionate-deduction exception in passage [1], but nothing in the claim file establishes the precondition that the hospital does not follow differential billings.

The summary supports a PAYABLE position for a second own damage claim under No Claim Bonus Protection, but passage [1] explicitly states that a second claim in the same policy year results in the No Claim Bonus reverting to nil.

The summary correctly applies the 30-day intimation requirement from passage [1], and because the claim file establishes that intimation occurred 37 days after birth, the position of NOT PAYABLE is supported by passage [1].
The summary concludes the claim is PAYABLE while citing a passage that states Nil Depreciation is limited to two claims per policy year and the claim file records this is the third claim [1].
The summary's basis correctly cites passage [1] to state the conditions required for road ambulance claims under the policy.
The summary's position that the claim is referred to the Special Investigation Unit due to being flagged for investigation is fully supported by passage [2].
The summary correctly applies the coverage rule for day care procedures for cataract surgery as supported by passage [1].
The summary correctly notes that the provided passages do not contain an alcohol or intoxication exclusion relevant to claim CLM-2026-00509.
The summary takes a referred position because the passages do not contain the motor claim intimation deadline, which is supported by passage [4].

The summary claims the 12-month waiting period for hernia under endorsement END-2026-02 [4] has been satisfied, but cover commenced on 2025-09-01 and the date of loss is 2026-08-01, meaning only 11 months have elapsed and the precondition for satisfying the 12-month waiting period is not met.
The policy indemnities and reimbursement window cited in the summary are fully supported by passages [4] and [1].
For claim CLM-2026-00526, the pre-authorisation requirement is supported by passages [1] and [2].
The summary correctly positions the claim as referred based on Endorsement END-2026-02 amending PW-HEALTH-002 as supported by passage [3].
The summary correctly establishes that arthrotomy of the hip joint with under 24 hours hospitalization is covered under the policy based on passages [1], [2], and [3].
The summary correctly supports the position that balloon sinuplasty is an eligible modern treatment and subject to the In-Patient Hospitalization Treatment Sum Insured using passage [1].
The summary correctly identifies that baby charges, cradle charges, and room fresheners are listed as items to be subsumed into room charges under Section E, which is supported by passage [1].
